text:
Update for Avery

Our tentatively scheduled October 8, 2026 launch cannot proceed as a production release.

Security review now completes October 12 at the earliest, and release needs completed approval. The review is owned by Nia and may require remediation. No new production date is authorized.

We can still hold a staging demo October 8 using synthetic data. I remain confident in the team to deliver this well.

Please confirm whether you accept the staging demo as next step.

Best,
Jordan
Engagement Lead
